presets.name: Podcast voice
presets.note: Steady 3:1 levelling for a spoken voice; about 4–6 dB off the loudest words.

presets.name: Interview levelling
presets.note: Gentler and slower, for two people at different distances from the microphone.

presets.name: Broadcast voice
presets.note: Firmer 4:1 control with a quick attack, for a voice that must sit forward.

presets.name: Gentle vocal
presets.note: Light 2:1 smoothing for a sung vocal; keeps the dynamics of the performance.

presets.name: Mix bus glue
presets.note: 2:1 with a slow attack on the whole mix; 1–2 dB of reduction holds it together.

presets.name: Drum bus
presets.note: 4:1 on peaks with a 10 ms attack, so the hits keep their front and the kit sounds fuller.

presets.name: Parallel drums
presets.note: Heavy 8:1 compression blended in at 40 %, for weight without losing the hits.

presets.name: Bass control
presets.note: 4:1 to keep a bass guitar or synth bass at an even level.

presets.name: Acoustic guitar
presets.note: 3:1 with a medium attack: evens the strumming and keeps the pick attack.
